description: Election Commission - Declare that A. Jesurajan Was elected as the member of the Ward No. 18 Udayanagar of Karachchi Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy for a member of a local government body (Karachchi Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It details the electoral process for declaring a new member elected due to a resignation, which falls under the category of electoral processes and related matters.
